summary: Iteration 82 - Operations Hub Testing Complete. All 47 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified for all 7 tabs: Reception Report, Routine Templates, Routine History, Pass Over Duties, Laundry Management, Compliance Checks, and Shift Scheduler.

reception_dashboard.description: GET /api/operations/reception/{property_id} - KPI stats and detail tables
tests: Returns stats: bookings_created, check_ins, check_outs, cancellations, routine_runs
Returns bookings, checkins, checkouts arrays with guest details
Date filtering with from_date and to_date query params
Works with property_id='all' for all properties
Requires authentication (401 without auth)
POST creates template with name, description, steps, role, shift
GET lists templates for property
PUT updates template fields
DELETE removes template
POST /{template_id}/start creates routine run with tasks
GET lists routine runs with filter by shift/status
GET /stats returns total, completed, incomplete, completion_rate
PUT /{run_id}/task/{index} marks task as complete
Automatically updates run status when all tasks complete
POST creates note with content, note_type, priority, owner
GET lists notes with filter by type/priority/status
PUT resolves note (sets resolved_by, resolved_at)
DELETE removes note
POST creates dispatch with room_number, guest_name, items, total_pieces
GET lists items with filter by status
PUT updates status (sent -> in_progress -> returned)
GET /stats returns total, sent, in_progress, returned, total_pieces
POST creates check with title, check_type, frequency, checklist_items
GET lists checks with filter by type/status
PUT completes check (sets result based on checklist)
DELETE removes check
POST creates staff with name, role, pay_type, pay_rate
GET lists staff with filter by role
PUT updates staff fields
DELETE removes staff
POST creates shift with staff_id, date, week_start, start_time, end_time
GET lists shifts with filter by week_start/status
PUT updates shift fields
DELETE removes shift
publish-all: Updates planned/draft shifts to published
mark-completed: Updates published/planned shifts to completed
approve-completed: Updates completed shifts to approved
clear-week: Deletes all shifts for a week
copy-week: Copies shifts from source to target week
Returns staff_id, staff_name, total_shifts, total_hours, total_pay
Calculates hours from start_time/end_time
Supports week_start filter

frontend_operations_hub_panel.description: Operations Hub panel with 7 internal tabs
tests: Panel accessible from sidebar via 'Operations Hub' button (data-testid='operations-hub-btn')
7 tabs: Reception, Routine Templates, Routine History, Pass Over Duties, Laundry, Compliance, Shifts
Tab navigation via data-testid='ops-tab-{id}'
5 KPI cards: Bookings Created, Check-ins, Check-outs, Cancellations, Routine Runs
Date filters (From/To) with Reset button
3 detail tables: Bookings Created, Check-ins, Check-outs
New Template button opens dialog
Dialog has Name, Description, Role, Shift, Steps fields
Add Step button adds new step input
Template cards show name, description, steps count, status
4 stats cards: Total Runs, Completed, In Progress, Completion Rate
Filter by Shift and Status
Table with Date, Template, Shift, User, Status, Tasks, Actions
View button opens run details with task checkboxes
New Note button opens dialog
Search and filter by Type/Priority/Status
Note cards show type/priority/status badges, content, author, timestamp
Resolve and Delete buttons on pending notes
4 action cards: Dispatch, Deliveries, Daily Usage, Stock
Items list with room, guest, pieces, status
Status filter dropdown
Start/Return buttons for status transitions
New Check button opens dialog
Dialog has Title, Description, Type, Frequency, Date, Inspector, Checklist fields
Check cards show type icon, title, status, result, checklist progress
Weekly calendar with date navigation (prev/next week)
Role filter buttons: All, housekeeper, maintenance, receptionist
Bulk action buttons: Publish All, Mark All Completed, Approve All Completed, Clear Week
Add Staff button opens dialog with Name, Role, Pay Type, Pay Rate
Staff rows show name, role, pay info
Calendar cells have + buttons to add shifts

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 82 tested the new Operations Hub feature with 7 modules: (1) Reception Dashboard - GET /api/operations/reception/{property_id} returns KPI stats and detail tables. (2) Routine Templates - CRUD at /api/operations/routine-templates with start routine at /{id}/start. (3) Routine History - GET/PUT at /api/operations/routine-history with task completion. (4) Pass Over Duties - CRUD at /api/operations/handover for shift handover notes. (5) Laundry Management - CRUD at /api/operations/laundry with status tracking. (6) Compliance Checks - CRUD at /api/operations/compliance for inspections. (7) Shift Scheduler - Staff CRUD at /api/shifts/staff, entries CRUD at /api/shifts/entries, bulk actions at /api/shifts/bulk/*. Frontend panel at sidebar 'Operations Hub' with 7 internal tabs.
